sentences.text:
Applicant :- Smt. Preeti Devi
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko.

And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Anumesh Mishra,Awadhesh Kumar Tiwari

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. Issuance of notice to the private respondents is dispensed with, as the matter is being decided.

2. The present application under Section 529 of B.N.S.S. has been filed with limited prayer for a direction to the learned Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate (A.T.S.), Lucknow, to decide the application under Section 320, Cr.P.C./359, Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, moved by the applicant in Case registered as State of U.P. v. Shivam Singh & ors., relating to Case Crime No. 173 of 2023 under Section 498A, 323, 342, 504, 506, I.P.C. and Section 3/4, Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Hasanganj,
District Lucknow, within a period prescribed by this court.
